summary: Bitcoin and Ethereum are stuck at monthly resistance levels with no clear breakout direction. Both are chopping at range highs - BTC around $23-24K with $20K as a critical support level, and ETH around $1.5K. Legacy markets including S&P 500 are also at resistance, creating market-wide confluence. The market is in a consolidation phase requiring patience before clearer directional moves emerge. Dollar correlations have weakened, offering some balance but the overall picture remains neutral.
